chapter_summary: Shen Feizhi continues to monitor Gu Suizhou's progress while maintaining a professional distance. Gu Suizhou, meanwhile, is orchestrating a fake romance with 'Number 9' to manipulate Shen Feizhi's attention, though his attempts at 'romance reports' via social media are largely ignored by Shen. Gu Suizhou reveals a manipulative and cold side when dealing with Number 9, using the man's debt to force him into a charade. The chapter ends with Gu Suizhou asking to move into Shen Feizhi's villa, prompting Shen to question his true intentions with his associate, C2.

new_characters.name: C2
new_characters.description: An associate of Shen Feizhi who is aware of the 'Small Worlds' and the 'original plot'. He acts as a sounding board for Shen.

new_characters.name: Number 9
new_characters.description: A young man with significant debt whom Gu Suizhou recruits to play the role of his romantic partner to deceive Shen Feizhi.
